description:
Join the Comenii Scrubs Affiliate Program

Welcome to the Comenii Scrubs Affiliate Program!
Partner with Comenii and start earning commissions by promoting our premium scrubs through your website, social media, or other marketing channels.

As a trusted brand in the scrubs industry, Comenii offers a wide range of stylish, comfortable, and high-quality scrubs 

Program Highlights

💰 Competitive Commission Rates

Earn 15%–20% commission on every qualifying sale generated through your affiliate links.

🔥 High Conversion Rates

Take advantage of our strong-performing products, exclusive promotions, and compelling offers that help maximize your earnings.

🍪 30-Day Cookie Duration

Enjoy a generous 30-day cookie window, ensuring you receive credit for purchases made within this period.

🎨 Professional Promotional Creatives

Access a variety of high-quality banners, text links, and product images to support your campaigns across different channels.

🤝 Dedicated Affiliate Support

Our experienced affiliate manager is available to provide personalized support, answer questions, and help you optimize performance.

How It Works

1️⃣ Sign Up
Join the program via UpPromote and get instant access to tracking links and marketing assets.

2️⃣ Promote
Share Comenii Scrubs using your affiliate links on your website, blog, social media, or email campaigns.

3️⃣ Earn Commissions
Earn commissions on every qualifying sale generated through your unique links.

4️⃣ Get Paid
Receive monthly payouts for all approved commissions.

Why Promote Comenii Scrubs?

👩‍⚕️ Evergreen & Profitable Niche

Scrubs are an essential, year-round product with consistent demand and a large professional audience.

⭐ High-Quality Products

We offer well-designed, comfortable, and durable scrubs that drive customer satisfaction and repeat purchases.

📣 Ongoing Marketing Support

Affiliates receive regular updates on promotions, seasonal campaigns, and marketing insights to help boost performance.

📈 Strong Conversion Performance

Our optimized website, competitive pricing, and attractive offers help convert traffic into sales.
payout_period: Payment will be made within 7–15 days.
